title: PCoreSet: Effective Active Learning through Knowledge Distillation from Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.00910v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely used framework for training compact, task-specific models by transferring the knowledge from teacher models. However, its application to active learning (AL), which aims to minimize annotation costs through iterative sample selection, remains underexplored. This gap stems from the fact that KD typically assumes access to sufficient labeled data, whereas AL operates in data-scarce scenarios where task-specific teacher models are often unavailable. In this paper, we first introduce ActiveKD, a framework that integrates AL with KD by leveraging the zero- and few-shot capabilities of large vision-language models (VLMs). A key aspect of ActiveKD is the structured prediction bias of VLMs--i.e., their predictions form clusters in the probability space. translated_title: PCoreSet：通过视觉-语言模型知识蒸馏实现高效主动学习
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏（KD）是一种广泛使用的框架，通过从教师模型迁移知识来训练紧凑的、面向特定任务的模型。然而，其在主动学习（AL）中的应用——主动学习旨在通过迭代式样本选择来最小化标注成本——仍未得到充分探索。这一空白源于：KD通常假设可以获取充足的标注数据，而AL则在数据稀缺的场景下运行，此时面向特定任务的教师模型往往不可用。在本文中，我们首先提出了ActiveKD，这是一个利用大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）的零样本和少样本能力将主动学习与知识蒸馏相结合的框架。ActiveKD的一个关键方面在于VLM的结构化预测偏差——即其预测在概率空间中形成聚类。我们将这种结构视为教师模型的归纳偏置，它捕捉了有利于学生学习的可泛化输出模式。为充分发挥...
tldr: 本文提出ActiveKD框架，利用大型视觉-语言模型的零样本/少样本预测作为教师信号，并将其结构化预测偏差视为有益的归纳偏置，从而在数据稀缺场景下将知识蒸馏与主动学习有效结合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ActiveKD, a framework that integrates active learning with knowledge distillation by leveraging the zero- and few-shot predictions of large vision-language models as teacher signals and treating their structured prediction bias as a beneficial inductive bias for data-scarce scenarios.
